title: MacOS Caps Lock Fix
description: Fixes Caps Lock hotbar keybinds on macOS, making Caps Lock work reliably as a Minecraft keybind.
body: Fixes Caps Lock hotbar keybinds on macOS, making Caps Lock work reliably as a Minecraft keybind. Normally, if you have a hotbar slot set to Caps Lock and press Caps Lock while it is already toggled on, Minecraft will not switch to that slot on macOS. This mod fixes that issue.
